did.unittitle: Prospect, N.Y. Moriah Congregational Church records, 1930-1943.
did.abstract: The Moriah Welsh Congregational church was gathered in 1856 in the village of Prospect, New York, as a Welsh-language church. At some point the name of the church was changed to Moriah Congregational Church. The church experienced significant and rapid membership decline in the early 1940s, resulting in the church's dissolution in 1943. This collection contains a single record book of administrative records.

bioghist.head: Historical Note
bioghist.p: The Moriah Welsh Congregational church was gathered in 1856 in the village of Prospect, New York, as a Welsh-language church. The church likely became an English-language church around 1896, possibly after merging with another church. At some point the name of the church was changed to Moriah Congregational Church. The church experienced significant and rapid membership decline in the early 1940s, resulting in the church's dissolution in 1943. The church building was given to the New York Conference following the church's dissolution.

custodhist.head: Custodial History
custodhist.p: Materials in this collection were given to the New York Conference of the United Church of Christ at an unknown time, likely following the church's dissolution. This collection was originally processed as part of the New York Conference records (RG0112) circa 1980.

acqinfo.head: Acquisition Information
acqinfo.p: Materials were donated to the Congregational Library & Archives by the New York Conference of the United Church of Christ in 1979; no accession number.

scopecontent.head: Scope and Contents
scopecontent.p: This collection contains a single record book of administrative records for the Moriah Congregational Church in Prospect, New York. The volume contains meeting minutes, correspondence, and records related to the 1943 dissolution of the church.
